description: This file contains JavaScript code defining Spanish (Puerto Rico) date culture information and related date manipulation functions, specifically for use with the Datejs library. It includes locale-specific settings such as day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for Date objects.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds the specified milliseconds to the Date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds the specified seconds to the Date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds the specified minutes to the Date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds the specified hours to the Date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds the specified days to the Date.

methods.name: addWeeks
methods.description: Adds the specified weeks to the Date.

methods.name: addMonths
methods.description: Adds the specified months to the Date.

methods.name: addYears
methods.description: Adds the specified years to the Date.
